as_told.title: Aztec crash dismissed as hoax; Steinman's book and the Ramseys' rehabilitation

plain: A craft is said to have crashed near Aztec, New Mexico, around 1948, and it was the first such crash case ever written about. The researcher Richard Dolan says he believes it, and he traces how it was told: early writers such as Frank Scully and JP Cahn, then a big book by a researcher named William Steinman, then a later revival by Scott Ramsey and Suzanne Ramsey, even though Wikipedia labels it a hoax. If true, it would be one of the first known recoveries of a crashed craft.
